Prudential Financial elects Jay Wintrob to Board of Directors

NEWARK, N.J., Nov. 23, 2026 – Prudential Financial, Inc. (NYSE: PRU) announced today that Jay Wintrob has been elected to the Board of Directors as an independent director, effective Jan. 1, 2027. He will serve on the Board’s Finance and Investment Committees.

Wintrob brings to Prudential over 40 years of leadership, investment, and financial services expertise. He most recently served as chief executive officer of Oaktree Capital Management, where he led the firm for nearly a decade, overseeing significant growth in assets under management and the development and expansion of its private debt and other investment strategies. Previously, Wintrob served as president and chief executive officer of American International Group Inc.’s (AIG) Domestic Life and Retirement Services businesses, where he oversaw a broad portfolio of retirement, investment, and life insurance products and services.

“Jay’s proven leadership and strong financial acumen make him an excellent addition to Prudential’s Board,” said Sandra Pianalto, director and chair of the Board’s Corporate Governance and Business Ethics Committee. “His experience leading complex financial services and investment businesses, combined with his deep knowledge of insurance and retirement, will further strengthen the Board’s breadth of expertise as Prudential continues to execute its strategy and position the company for long-term growth. We are delighted to welcome him.”

Prior to AIG, Wintrob held a number of senior leadership positions at SunAmerica Inc., culminating in his role as president and chief executive officer. He also served as president of SunAmerica Investments, overseeing the company’s invested asset portfolio during a period of significant portfolio growth. He spent his early career at the law firm O’Melveny & Myers LLP, where he worked on mergers and acquisitions, securities underwriting, and general corporate matters.

Wintrob holds a Juris Doctor and bachelor’s degree from the University of California, Berkley. He currently serves on the boards of Third Point Private Capital Partners and Third Point Private Capital Income Fund, where he is a member of the Audit and Nominating and Corporate Governance Committees.

About Prudential Financial

Prudential Financial, Inc. (NYSE: PRU), a global financial services leader and premier active global investment manager with approximately $1.6 trillion in assets under management as of Sept. 30, 2026, has operations in the United States, Asia, Europe, and Latin America. Prudential’s diverse and talented employees help make lives better and create financial opportunity for more people by expanding access to investing, insurance, and retirement security. Prudential’s iconic Rock symbol has stood for strength, stability, expertise, and innovation for more than 150 years. For more information, please visit news.prudential.com.
